title: Matam Bhira Da Kardi Gayee Shaam Zahra Jayee
body:
Matam Bhira Da Kardi Gayee Shaam Zahra Jayee (x2)
Sajjad Baaqi Zindagi Ratt Rohndiya Nibayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nowee Dhi Shaam Taee, Sajaad Si Jawaaney
Babay Da Hukm Milya, Tera Shaam Imtihaan Eh
Phupiya De Naal Jaana, Tu Bann Ke Saarbaan Eh
Yaq Damm Zaeefee Chaah Gayi, Inj Chot Dil The Ayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth Mill Sakina Bachra, Waapass Watan Nu Chalya
Rowan Dhi He Ijaazatt, Sanu Chadiraan Wi Milya
Hunn Teek Ho Gya Neh, Abid Dhi Zakhmi Talyaa
Qaidaan Chu Mill Gayee Eh, Tere Weer Nu Rihayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Hurmall Da Teer Jhall Ke, Nezey The Charr Ke Asghar
Zanjeer Toqh Paakay, Babay Deh Naal Baqir
Rassiyaa De Wich Sakina, Deway Duhaee Rokar
Masoom De Rahay Ne, Mazloom Dhi Gawayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal Hussain Wich Jad, Ayi Behen Ho Aseer Eh
Akhay Shimmr Kameena, Pehchaan Apna Weer Eh
Ro Akhay Hatth Baanday Ne, Kiway Hataawa Teer Eh
Koyi Behen Inj Kadi Nahi, Mayatt Bhira Te Ayee
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Hussain Haatir, Turbatt Batool Chori
Sarr Weer Tu Hai Waari, Zainab Ne Apni Jori
Khanjar Shimmr Ne Pall Wich, Zainab Dhi Aas Tori
Rab Janay Kiwey She Gayi, Shabbir Dhi Judayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kismat Ali Di Dhi Di, Tanweer Bahoo Ajeeb Eh
Na Weer Da Kaffan Eh, Itni Huwee Ghareeb Eh
Zindaan Bann Gaeh Ne, Zainab Deh Kyu Naseeb Eh
Darbaar Shaam Da Eh, Rassiyaa Kharee He Payee
